mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia, which may potentiate primaquine's hemolytic effects and increase cardiac arrhythmia risk in G6PD-deficient patients.
action: Monitor electrolytes regularly; ensure adequate potassium and magnesium supplementation; assess G6PD status before primaquine use; consider alternative antimalarial if significant electrolyte depletion occurs.
